This year, we will be hosting our monthly programs in a variety of locations around Hudson. Watch this site, our newsletter and our social media accounts for details, but be sure to mark your calendar for these upcoming events:

September 10 – Hudson and the Underground Railroad
Barlow Community Center

October 8 – A Tour of Hudson’s Archives
Hudson Library & Historical Society North Room

November 12 – A Viewing of the Frederick Douglas Movie
Western Reserve Academy Chapel

January 14 – Program to be announced
Laurel Lake Community Room

February 11 – Introducing the Akron History Museum
Laurel Lake Community Room

March 11 – The History of the WRA Observatory
Laurel Lake Community Room

April 8 – Program to be announced
Laurel Lake Community Room

May 13 – Annual Meeting of Members
Location to be announced

Note: All meetings – except for the May Members’ Annual Meeting – are free and open to the public.

Annual Meeting for HHA Members

Note: All meetings – except for the May Members’ Annual Meeting – are free and open to the public. Unless otherwise noted, all meetings are held at Barlow Community Center and begin at 7 p.m.

Mark your calendars, and join us! Dates, guests and locations are subject to change, so check our website regularly for updates and announcements.
